correctness.rationale: Complete exact graph-isomorphism enumeration gives 1+2+7+29 cases. Full nonempty face sets are enumerated from independent four-subsets; an explicit matching is checked on all Hasse relations for global directed acyclicity, leaving one critical 0-simplex and only r critical 5-simplices. Discrete Morse theory implies the exact integral wedge decomposition. A separate program recomputes mod-two boundary ranks independently for all 39 cases. Scripts square4_verify.py and square4_homology.py and captured outputs are bundled. Limits: finite s<=4 only.

value.rationale: A complete finite cutoff for the first previously untreated forbidden independent-set size k=4 in a specific 2026 open Conjecture 5. It covers all 21 length-four corner-gluing types, which are exactly outside the prior edge-only theorem at this length. Nonconstant sphere multiplicities among equal-order graphs quantify new attachment-sensitive homotopy behavior. Finite scope is intrinsic and useful, while no unproved general recurrence or infinite claim is made.
